title: Tell us about your business
hint: Business name, what you do, and where you serve customers. Local, remote, or both?

title: Who should the website attract?
hint: Your ideal customer, what they need help with, and the 1–3 services to feature.

title: What should visitors do next?
hint: Choose a main action: request a quote, book, call, message, buy, or other. Who receives requests, and what happens next?

title: What must the first demo get right?
hint: Up to three essentials: service details, prices or quote process, common questions, or examples of your work.

title: What should it look and feel like?
hint: Your logo, colors, approved photos, or 1–2 websites you like. No assets yet? Describe the style.

title: What do you already use?
hint: Your current site and any email, calendar, booking, customer/job management, or payment tools to keep.

title: What are your timing and budget expectations?
hint: Target date. Optional: setup budget and comfortable monthly cost. “Not sure” is welcome.

title: Any special features or private details?
hint: Mention payments, customer sign-in, private documents, sensitive information, or anything to keep off the site. Share no private records.
